page.content:
Car-sized Mars Science Laboratory rover in Gale Crater since 2012.

How Curiosity connects

  • Faction: Mars Exploration Program — Curiosity is the Mars Science Laboratory rover of the Mars program.
  • Item: Perseverance — Perseverance followed Curiosity as NASA's next nuclear-powered Mars rover.

What is Curiosity?

Curiosity sky-craned into Gale Crater to read ancient habitable environments, climbing Aeolis Mons and sampling rocks with a chemistry lab on wheels.

Key threads lead to Mars Exploration Program and Perseverance.
